title: Move the finalized MASTER-SOURCE-SPLIT-PHASE1 task record from in_progress/ to completed/
objective: MASTER-SOURCE-SPLIT-PHASE1's own record was updated in place to status:completed while still physically sitting in .ai/state/tasks/in_progress/, which deregisters it as an active claim (the guard's activeTaskFor reads the file's own status field, not its folder) and blocks the mv needed to relocate it -- the exact same race condition documented and fixed once already this session via COORD-TASK-FILE-CLEANUP. This tiny task exists solely to regain an active claim and perform that one file move.
validations: DONE: moved MASTER-SOURCE-SPLIT-PHASE1.json from in_progress/ to completed/ and this record from planned/ to in_progress/ in the same Bash call, then finalized this record to completed.
risks: This reveals the same real gap noted in COORD-AUTOMATION-TOOLING's own risk log: an atomic 'move + status change' allowance would remove the need for this workaround entirely.
